invitationOverlay.cardIntro: we warmly invite you to celebrate our wedding with us

story.paragraphOne: Our story actually began a little earlier than we knew at the time. Our paths first crossed long before we became 'us.' In January 2017, we met again, and a chance encounter quickly turned into something more. On February 14, 2017, we officially became a couple.
story.paragraphTwo: Since then, many years, trips, adventures, and countless memories have passed. We've lived, laughed, made plans, and fulfilled our dream of owning a home. In early 2026, we got engaged and are now looking forward to the next chapter of our story – and especially to celebrating it with you. 🤍
story.quote: Today, tomorrow, and every day to come – always you.

message.paragraphOne: Every relationship is a journey, and we are incredibly grateful that you are part of our story.
message.paragraphTwo: From the first shared moments to this special day – you have accompanied us, supported us, and laughed with us.
message.highlight: Thank you for celebrating with us. We look forward to unforgettable moments with all of you.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: We would love for you to orient yourself to our natural, warm color palette. 👗 A small note on shoe choice: Our ceremony will take place outside on the lawn before the evening program continues indoors.

items.question: When does it start?
items.answer: Feel free to arrive around 2:30 PM – there will already be a small drink, and Lasse will also be there. Our free ceremony begins at 3:00 PM. 🥂

items.question: Can I bring children?
items.answer: We would like to celebrate our special day in the circle of adults. 🤍

items.question: Where can I park at the venue?
items.answer: Free parking is available right next to the venue. Simply enter the location into your GPS and follow the parking signs on-site. 🚗

items.question: Where can I stay after the celebration?
items.answer: We have reserved a room block for our guests at Hotel Esinger Hof. You can stay there at our agreed special rate. 🏨 Alternatively, you can also sleep in your car in the parking lot.

items.question: Are there vegetarian and vegan options?
items.answer: Yes! Our buffet will include both vegetarian and vegan options. If you have allergies or other intolerances, please let us know via the RSVP tool when you respond. 🌿

items.question: Can I take photos?
items.answer: Absolutely! 📸 During the ceremony, we kindly ask you to keep your phones in your pockets and enjoy the moment with us – our photographer will take care of the pictures. Afterward, we look forward to your snapshots, which you can share with us via a photo QR code!

items.question: What can we gift you?
items.answer: Our biggest wish is to travel to Canada for a month after the wedding – this time to Vancouver, Vancouver Island, and the Rocky Mountains. 🇨🇦 If you would like to support us with a small contribution to our honeymoon, we would be very grateful. And if you prefer to gift something for our home, we have also created a small wish list for you. 🏡

items.question: I want to give a speech or contribute something – who should I contact?
items.answer: Please contact our toastmaster Søren for this. He coordinates the evening program, plans the contributions, and will let you know in advance when it's your turn. This way, we can ensure everything finds its right place. 🎤

contacts.bottomText: Whether it's organizational questions, accommodations, or just a friendly chat – these wonderful people are happy to help you.
